# Behavioral Design Hub

> Evidence-based behavioral design teardowns of 30 consumer products, 17 pattern pages, and ~435 comparison pages. Every technique cited to academic or regulatory sources (Thaler, Cialdini, EU CPC Network, GDPR, Journal of Behavioral Finance, CHI proceedings, etc.).
